data_fields.name: fill_rounding
data_fields.donor_constant: int() truncation (floor); fix to ceil above zero

best_idea: A health orb that fills from the bottom off a clamped hp/max ratio, with a tap-to-pin tooltip for touch screens where there is no hover.
decision_why: Keep the tap-to-pin tooltip and bottom-up fill rule with clamp, ceil and zero-max fixes; the orb art stays ours.
acceptance: On a 375 px phone, tapping the orb pins hp / max until a second tap; unit test asserts orbFillRect(1,100).h===1, orbFillRect(150,100).h===80, orbFillRect(5,0).h===0.
